main.description: Crawl EU legal acts from EUR-Lex via its public SPARQL endpoint (https://publications.europa.eu/webapi/rdf/sparql). Phase 2 MVP ingests regulation / directive / decision metadata by CELEX number. Full act text fetch lands in a later PR. Writes to vertex_houbun_statute. Attribution required (CC-BY-SA via ©European Union).

celex.description: CELEX identifier (e.g. '32016R0679' for GDPR). Mutually exclusive with since.

since.description: ISO 8601 date — fetch acts registered after this cutoff.

actType.description: Limit to a single act type. Applies to since mode.
